# Impeccable DOM helpers

Upstream: https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable
Commit: 414603bf14c7a344edb466bb1f85690c77ce8b7d
File: skill/scripts/live-browser-dom.js (unmodified)
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.

Design Harness reuses the upstream browser DOM helpers for target descriptions, review UI ownership, UI mounting and modal top-layer support. The plugin implements the json-render mapping, numbered annotations and Codex Agent event adapter. It does not claim to distribute the full Impeccable Live server or use its source-rewriting backend.
